fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: A shove that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Closed Ranks
fusions.desc: Raises a 5-tile wall of warm bodies ahead of you for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and each enemy it catches takes a blow that deals 12 damage and is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Circle the Calves
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
